pulserver#

pulserver contains plugin contracts, protocol types, and convenient re-exports for sequence authoring. Authoring helpers are also available in the more focused pulserver.pypulseq namespace.

Types#

pulserver.Sequence

pulserver.PulseqSequence

Base class that every pulserver sequence plugin must satisfy.

pulserver.Module

Base class for a reusable, stateful sequence fragment.

pulserver.UIParam

Convenience namespace exposing all canonical protocol keys.

pulserver.Validate

Validation strategy applied to a protocol parameter.

pulserver.ParamKind

Expected protocol value kind for a key.

pulserver.InputMode

GE interpreter input mode for a numeric parameter.

pulserver.FloatKey

Canonical keys whose values are expected to be float-like params.

pulserver.IntKey

Canonical keys whose values are expected to be int-like params.

pulserver.BoolKey

Canonical keys whose values are expected to be boolean params.

pulserver.EnumKey

Canonical keys whose values are expected to be enum/string-list params.

pulserver.SequenceType

Pulse sequence family shown in the UI.

pulserver.ImagingMode

Acquisition dimensionality shown in the UI.

pulserver.PreparationType

Preparation pulse family shown in the UI.

pulserver.TriggerType

Trigger source selection shown in the UI.

pulserver.TypeinFloatParam

Float parameter displayed as a GE type-in control.

pulserver.DropdownFloatParam

Float parameter displayed as a GE type-in plus dropdown control.

pulserver.TypeinIntParam

Int parameter displayed as a GE type-in control.

pulserver.DropdownIntParam

Int parameter displayed as a GE type-in plus dropdown control.

pulserver.BoolParam

Boolean toggle parameter.

pulserver.StringListParam

String-list parameter with an explicit selected value.

pulserver.Description

Read-only description or section header row.

Protocol and ProtocolValue are the mapping and value type aliases used by the protocol helpers below.

Protocol handling#

pulserver.expected_param_kind

Return the expected protocol value kind for a canonical key.

pulserver.enum_options

Return allowed string options for enum-backed UI controls.

pulserver.make_enum_param

Create a StringListParam for an enum-backed control.

pulserver.validate_protocol_entry

Validate that a key/value pair matches the expected protocol value type.

pulserver.validate_protocol

Validate all key/value pairs in a protocol mapping.

pulserver.param_to_dict

Convert a protocol value object to a plain dictionary.

pulserver.dict_to_param

Reconstruct a protocol value object from a plain dictionary.

pulserver.protocol_to_dict

Serialize an entire protocol to nested plain dictionaries.

pulserver.dict_to_protocol

Deserialize nested plain dictionaries back to a typed protocol.

pulserver.set_protocol_value

Set a serialized protocol value and synchronize dropdown indices.

pulserver.run_cli

Run a plugin's offline CLI from a declarative flag→protocol mapping.

RF pulses and preparation#

pulserver.make_hard_pulse

Wrap pypulseq.make_block_pulse() in the RF module protocol.

pulserver.make_adiabatic_pulse

Wrap pypulseq.make_adiabatic_pulse() in the RF module protocol.

pulserver.make_sigpy_pulse

Create an SLR pulse without requiring SigPy.

pulserver.make_slr_pulse

Create an SLR pulse without requiring SigPy.

pulserver.make_frequency_selective_pulse

Create a non-spatial SLR pulse centered at freq_offset.

pulserver.make_slice_selective_pulse

Create a slice/slab-selective SLR module with selection and rephasing gradients.

pulserver.make_spsp_pulse

Create an alternating-gradient SLR spectral-spatial pulse.

pulserver.make_spatially_selective_pulse

Design a 2D or 3D small-tip pulse on an existing gradient trajectory.

pulserver.make_spiral_selective_pulse

Create a 2D selective pulse using pulserver.pypulseq.arbgrad.spiral.

pulserver.make_2d_selective_pulse

Create a 2D selective pulse on a supplied trajectory or a spiral.

pulserver.make_3d_selective_pulse

Create a 3D selective pulse on an existing EPI/spiral trajectory.

pulserver.make_inversion_pulse

Create a nominal pi inversion pulse, optionally slice/slab selective.

pulserver.make_refocusing_pulse

Create a nominal pi SLR refocusing pulse.

pulserver.make_mt_pulse

Create a conventional off-resonant Gaussian MT saturation pulse.

pulserver.make_ihmt_pulse

Create an alternating dual-offset inhomogeneous-MT pulse train.

pulserver.make_bloch_siegert_pulse

Create an off-resonant Fermi pulse and its Bloch-Siegert constants.

pulserver.make_t2prep_pulse

Create T2-prep, or hybrid T1/T2-prep with final_tip='down'.

pulserver.make_t1t2_prep_pulse

Create hybrid T1/T2 preparation by storing the final magnetization on -z.

pulserver.make_diffusion_prep

Create a canonical z-axis diffusion preparation at its full b-value.

pulserver.make_fat_saturation_pulse

Create an SLR fat-saturation pulse with NOPOS/NOROT scope labels.

Encoding, gradients, and timing#

pulserver.make_line_readout

Create a 2D or 3D Cartesian line readout module.

pulserver.make_epi_readout

Create a 2D or 3D blipped or flyback EPI readout module.

pulserver.make_fse_readout

Create a 2D or 3D FSE readout from a refocusing RF module.

pulserver.make_radial_readout

Create a reusable 2D radial readout module.

pulserver.make_spiral_readout

Create a reusable 2D spiral readout module.

pulserver.make_rosette_readout

Create a reusable 2D rosette readout module.

pulserver.make_noncartesian_3d_readout

Promote a native 3D non-Cartesian gradient to a readout module.

pulserver.make_zte_readout

Create a continuous-gradient ZTE readout module.

pulserver.make_crusher

Build a single-axis crusher trapezoid.

pulserver.make_phase_encoding

Build the phase-encode template trapezoid and per-view area array.

pulserver.make_phase_blip

Create a phase blip spanning steps Cartesian k-space cells.

pulserver.make_spoiler

Build a non-selective 3-axis crusher/spoiler gradient set.

pulserver.calc_adc_timing

Return feasible ADC dwell and readout duration on both time rasters.

Sampling and schedules#

pulserver.chunk_indices

pulserver.linear_order

pulserver.outer_inner_order

pulserver.outer_product

pulserver.sampled_lines

Return the sampled view indices for uniform undersampling + ACS block.

pulserver.fse_linear_order

Linear (raster) echo-train ordering over a (ky, kz) point set.

pulserver.fse_radial_order

Center-out radial (wedge) echo-train ordering.

pulserver.fse_radial_adaptive_order

Adaptive radial echo-train ordering (individually parameterized trains).

pulserver.fse_shuffling_order

Randomly shuffled echo-train ordering (T2 Shuffling).

pulserver.random_mask

Generate a uniform-random undersampling mask with a calibration region.

pulserver.caipirinha_mask

Generate a 2D CAIPIRINHA lattice undersampling mask.

pulserver.poisson_disc_mask

Generate a variable-density Poisson-disc undersampling mask.

pulserver.from_mask

Build absolute Cartesian trains while retaining mask/order separately.

pulserver.from_relative_shifts

pulserver.skipped_caipi

pulserver.radial_2d

pulserver.golden_angles

pulserver.uniform_angles

pulserver.golden_means_3d

pulserver.spiral_phyllotaxis

pulserver.directions_to_rotations

pulserver.slice_groups

pulserver.make_rf_spoiling_schedule

Return the standard quadratic RF-spoiling phase schedule in radians.

pulserver.make_phase_cycling_schedule

Repeat an arbitrary phase cycle to length entries, in radians.

pulserver.make_traps_schedule

Return an Alsop-style TRAPS refocusing schedule in radians.
